设 m,n,k 均为正整数，满足 m≥2，n≥k≥2。已知非负实数 x₁≥x₂≥⋯≥xₙ≥0 满足 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 及 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k。求证 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。

【原证明】
第一步：假设结论不成立。
假设 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ<1。记 t=∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ，u=xₖ。
由条件可知 0≤u≤xᵢ≤t<1 (1≤i≤k)。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。

第二步：估计前 k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。
又因为 u≤xᵢ<1，所以 (xᵢ−u)(1−xᵢ)≥0。
展开并整理，得 xᵢ²≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
因此 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
对 i=1,2,…,k 求和，得到
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m ≤ ∑_{i=1}^k (xᵢ−u+uxᵢ) = t−ku+ut。

第三步：估计后 n−k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
故 ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m ≤ u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

第四步：合并两个估计。
将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。

第五步：利用已知条件推出矛盾。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

by
  intro m n k hm hkn hk x hx_nonneg hx_anti hpow hsum
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkm1lt : k - 1 < n := by omega
  let umem : Fin n := ⟨k - 1, hkm1lt⟩
  let A : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)
  let B : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ¬ (i : ℕ) < k)
  by_contra hneg
  let t : ℝ := A.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)
  let u : ℝ := x umem
  have hnegA : ¬ (A.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i) ≥ 1) := by
    simpa [A] using hneg
  have source_step_0 : ¬ (A.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i) ≥ 1) := hnegA
  have source_step_1 : t = A.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i) ∧ u = x umem := by
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have htlt : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact not_le.mp hnegA
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => hx_nonneg i)
  have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hx_nonneg umem
  have hkmem_lt : k - 1 < k := by omega
  have hu_mem : umem ∈ A := by
    dsimp [A, umem]
    simp [hkmem_lt]
  have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
    dsimp [u, t]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i hi => hx_nonneg i) hu_mem
  have hxi_le_t_of_mem : ∀ i ∈ A, x i ≤ t := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp [t]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj => hx_nonneg j) hi
  have hxi_ge_u_of_mem : ∀ i ∈ A, u ≤ x i := by
    intro i hi
    have hi_lt : (i : ℕ) < k := by
      simpa [A] using hi
    have hi_le_umem : i ≤ umem := by
      change (i : ℕ) ≤ k - 1
      omega
    dsimp [u]
    exact hx_anti i umem hi_le_umem
  have hxi_lt_one_of_mem : ∀ i ∈ A, x i < 1 := by
    intro i hi
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hxi_le_t_of_mem i hi) htlt
  have hu_lt_one : u < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_t htlt
  have source_step_2 : 0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ (∀ i, i ∈ A → 0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t ∧ t < 1) := by
    refine ⟨hu_nonneg, hu_le_t, htlt, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    exact ⟨hu_nonneg, hxi_ge_u_of_mem i hi, hxi_le_t_of_mem i hi, htlt⟩
  have hxi_le_u_of_mem : ∀ i ∈ B, x i ≤ u := by
    intro i hi
    have hik : k ≤ (i : ℕ) := by
      have hnot : ¬ (i : ℕ) < k := by
        simpa [B] using hi
      omega
    have hu_le_i : umem ≤ i := by
      change k - 1 ≤ (i : ℕ)
      omega
    dsimp [u]
    exact hx_anti umem i hu_le_i
  have source_step_3 : ∀ i, i ∈ B → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u ∧ u < 1 := by
    intro i hi
    exact ⟨hx_nonneg i, hxi_le_u_of_mem i hi, hu_lt_one⟩
  have hxi_le_one_of_mem : ∀ i ∈ A, x i ≤ 1 := by
    intro i hi
    exact le_of_lt (hxi_lt_one_of_mem i hi)
  have source_step_4 : ∀ i, i ∈ A → x i ^ m ≤ x i ^ 2 := by
    intro i hi
    exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (hx_nonneg i) (hxi_le_one_of_mem i hi) hm
  have source_step_5 : ∀ i, i ∈ A → 0 ≤ (x i - u) * (1 - x i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hxi_ge_u_of_mem i hi))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt (hxi_lt_one_of_mem i hi)))
  have source_step_6 : ∀ i, i ∈ A → x i ^ 2 ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi
    have hprod := source_step_5 i hi
    have h : (x i - u) * (1 - x i) = x i - u + u * x i - (x i)^2 := by ring
    nlinarith [hprod, h]
  have source_step_7 : ∀ i, i ∈ A → x i ^ m ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi
    exact le_trans (source_step_4 i hi) (source_step_6 i hi)
  have hsumA_le : A.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) ≤ A.sum (fun i => x i - u + u * x i) := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => source_step_7 i hi)
  have hA_card : A.card = k := by
    dsimp [A]
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    calc
      (∑ x_1 : Fin n, if (x_1 : ℕ) < k then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
          = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (if i < k then (1 : ℕ) else 0) := by
              simpa using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i : ℕ => if i < k then (1 : ℕ) else 0) n)

            ext i
            simp [Finset.mem_range]
            omega

          simp

            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          rw [hsum_expr]
          have hconst : A.sum (fun _ : Fin n => u) = (A.card : ℝ) * u := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          have hmul : A.sum (fun i => u * x i) = u * A.sum (fun i => x i) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          rw [hconst, hmul]
          dsimp [t]
          ring
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by rw [hA_card]
  have source_step_9 : ∀ i, i ∈ B → x i ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u := by
    intro i hi
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := hxi_le_u_of_mem i hi
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hx_nonneg i
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_u hu_lt_one
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxi_lt_one
    have hm1 : 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
    have hpow' : x i ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i ^ 1 :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one hxi_nonneg hxi_le_one hm1
    constructor
    · simpa using hpow'
    · exact hxi_le_u
  have source_step_10 : ∀ i, i ∈ B → x i ^ m ≤ u * x i := by
    intro i hi
    have hpow' := (source_step_9 i hi).1
    have hx_nonneg' : 0 ≤ x i := hx_nonneg i
    have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
    calc
      x i ^ m = x i ^ ((m - 1) + 1) := by rw [hm_eq]
      _ = x i ^ (m - 1) * x i := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ u * x i := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow' hx_nonneg'
  have hsumB_le : B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) ≤ u * B.sum (fun i => x i) := by
    calc
      B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m)
          ≤ B.sum (fun i => u * x i) := by
              exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => source_step_10 i hi)
      _ = u * B.sum (fun i => x i) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have source_step_11 : B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) ≤ u * B.sum (fun i => x i) := hsumB_le
  have source_step_12 : n = k → B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) = 0 ∧ B.sum (fun i => x i) = 0 := by
    intro hnk
    have hBempty : B = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr
      intro i hi
      have hnot : ¬ (i : ℕ) < k := by
        simpa [B] using hi
      have hi_lt_n : (i : ℕ) < n := i.isLt
      omega
    simp [hBempty]
  have hsum_split_pow :
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m)) =
        A.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) + B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) := by
    dsimp [A, B]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)))
        (p := fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)
        (f := fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m)]
  have hsum_split_x :
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)) =
        A.sum (fun i => x i) + B.sum (fun i => x i) := by
    dsimp [A, B]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)))
        (p := fun i : Fin n => (i : ℕ) < k)
        (f := fun i : Fin n => x i)]
  have source_step_13 :
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m)) ≤
        t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)) := by
    calc
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m))
          = A.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) + B.sum (fun i => x i ^ m) := hsum_split_pow
      _ ≤ (t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t) + (u * B.sum (fun i => x i)) := by
          exact add_le_add source_step_8 hsumB_le
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)) := by
          rw [hsum_split_x]
          dsimp [t]
          ring
  have source_step_14 :
      u * (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)) ≤ u * (k : ℝ) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hu_nonneg
  have source_step_15 :
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m)) < 1 := by
    calc
      (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i ^ m))
          ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i)) := source_step_13
      _ ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (k : ℝ) := by
          linarith [source_step_14]
      _ = t := by ring
      _ < 1 := htlt
  have source_step_16 : False := by
    linarith [source_step_15, hpow]
  have source_step_17 : A.sum (fun i : Fin n => x i) ≥ 1 := by
    exfalso
    exact source_step_16
  exact source_step_16
